items.question: How do I get access?
items.answer: Registration is open. Create an account, then email hello{'@'}unlimgpt.com to have credits added manually. Model requests are available after credits are added.

items.question: What are credits and model rates?
items.answer: Credits are one balance for official models. A top-up shows exactly how many credits you receive; the rate depends on your VIP level and top-ups over the last 30 days. For models charged by actual usage, the final debit appears in your activity after the request.

items.question: How is Jailbreak different?
items.answer: Jailbreak answers without needless refusals and comes with a subscription: if GPT or Claude limits an answer, the request continues with fewer restrictions while your chosen model stays the same.

items.question: What can purchased credits be spent on?
items.answer: Purchased credits never expire and are spent only on OpenAI and Anthropic models. Jailbreak uses your monthly subscription credits.

items.question: Can I connect my own code?
items.answer: Yes. Create a key in your account and change the base URL in the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK — the rest of your code stays the same.

items.question: Who can see my chats?
items.answer: Your chat history is available only in your account. API history keeps the time, endpoint and status of each request — never its text.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Online payment is not connected yet. Credits are added manually: email hello{'@'}unlimgpt.com.
